checks.evidence: Real Space jump lifts the character while camera height and projection remain unchanged.

checks.name: movement and shared collision physics
checks.evidence: Arrows/WASD, ground click-to-walk and collision against the original desk geometry work in the orthographic scene.

checks.name: complete office dialogs
checks.evidence: Shared Issues/PR/Queue, Boss, Smartphone, Services, Whiteboard, Meeting, Search, Settings, view controls and Plan Comparison open from the same menu with close/Esc focus recovery.

checks.name: real arcade interaction
checks.evidence: Boss Control Center launches playable Minesweeper with its original camera and canvas; closing restores the orthographic view and controls.

checks.name: menu and palette recovery
checks.evidence: The full menu and command palette have top-right close buttons and restore controls immediately.

checks.name: shared worker terminal
checks.evidence: Clicking the rendered worker opens the existing terminal and real shell input without a replacement worker/session.

checks.name: office visual and zoom
checks.evidence: Two screenshots show the actual 3D office artwork in a flat cutaway projection, original HUD, elevator and fixtures; wheel zoom updates pointer projection.

checks.name: rooftop game interaction
checks.evidence: The actual shared darts interaction starts its aiming activity on the roof and E returns to the top-down view.

checks.name: real car interaction
checks.evidence: The original car interaction enters the driver, WASD emits real car.drive frames, and E exits back to the plan view.

checks.name: rooftop and garage access
checks.evidence: Real elevator rides reach the full rooftop/bar/game fixtures and garage/car fixtures, then return to the selected office floor.

checks.name: other maps
checks.evidence: Castle and Station load and stay playable through the existing map.set server API; returns to Office without changing worker/session IDs.

checks.name: real golf interaction

checks.name: activity camera and registries
checks.evidence: Golf, cars, bar games, arcade and climbing use the original shared activity modules; camera ownership switches to perspective and back without another session.

checks.name: multiplayer

checks.name: direct view toggle
checks.evidence: Visible HUD buttons switch 2D to 3D and back, preserving floor and worker sessions.

checks.evidence: No page errors across Office, rooftop, garage, alternate maps and view switching.
